functions.verifyProfileEvidence: (selection, configuration, artifacts, observations, attempt, evidenceSource) -> BOUND ProfileEvidenceV1 or fixed error; unbound attempt kind is explicitly not accepted as a bound carrier
functions.serializeProfileEvidence: (bound ProfileEvidenceV1 OR exact UnboundRUAttemptV1 data, transientCredentialValues) -> canonical UTF8 bytes, distinct closed kind/schema per branch; no new export/action language

configuration: existing factory-bound ServedProfileConfiguration, every actual field preserved; compare profile/history to selection and fixture digest to parsed artifacts

TX.coverage: ConformanceArtifactSource exact current coverageVersion1 bytes; preserve colon-joined assertion binding convention, not RU dot spelling
TX.binding: create canonical TXv2 bundle from exact supplied source; full required ownership map includes null for234 missing current IDs; no new TX index/action language

observations: closed array ordered by RU shard order or one TX owner transactional-baseline; each record has ownerId, sourceCommit, configuration(existing brand), runtimeConfigurationIdentity, exactConfiguration(non-secret transport record), ready summaries, reportSource(exact raw existing wrapper bytes containing result), expectedReportSha256, lifecycle record. Absent/failed reports can be null; no report substituted by wrapper. Report has existing ConformanceRunResultv4 fields, no custom runner result type.
reportExtraction: parse bounded exact existing wrapper source; read existing .result without altering it; rawWrapperSha256 binds exact bytes; canonicalResultSha256 is explicitly a derived digest, never an installed payload normalization. Unused unknown wrapper fields are neither trusted nor serialized. Compare whitelisted source/config/session fields to trusted context; no caller structural cast becomes a bound configuration. Exact raw wrapper parse uses error-contract fixed manifest kind/label helper boundary. Authored outcomes use outcome-join-contract family-specific lanes and false-before-missing precedence.
attempt: closed data: outcome running|failed|observed; failureStages subset execution/assertion/cleanup/credential-check; owner states from existing writer; reported lifecycle facts/explicit unknown; sourceDirty boolean|null (null unavailable never false); unresolvedConditions list from frozen plan/adapters, not N/A certificates
ownData: reuse ownData/copySourceBytes intrinsic capture before parsing; reject proxies/getters/unknown API keys/functions; detach supplied source bytes and evidence data once. No file IO/process/network/service callbacks in pure module.
noTruthByHash: Expected hashes and labels establish byte identity only; trusted external installer/owner/root run provenance establishes truth. The carrier never verifies a service merely by agreement of its own assertions.
preBindingRU: Existing writer constructor/set/source/path/credentials and start/acquired have NO actual served configuration. Writer emits only distinct UnboundRUAttemptV1 until first safe genuine returned(report) supplies its existing factory-bound configuration. No fake bindServedProfileConfiguration call, new RU signature/caller parameter or guessed ready/target data.

TXWrapperHandoff.state: FULL active TX handoff/error isolation contract
TXWrapperHandoff.genuineCapture: Immediately before original onObserved invocation detach genuine result/sessions/baseline plus actual source/entry. The returned genuine observed object and existing product assertions are not replaced by carrier state.
TXWrapperHandoff.hookType: existing private onObserved void | {bytes:Uint8Array,rawWrapperSha256:string}; optional carrierPath remains positive-only
TXWrapperHandoff.singleSerialization: Existing positive closure owns EXACT original literal field order sourceCommit,entry,...observed,supplemental,sequenceMemberSupplemental,principalSupplemental,conditionalSupplemental. If legacy output OR carrierPath: ONE JSON.stringify(wrapper,null,2)+newline, ONE UTF8 encoding. Legacy file uses these exact bytes; carrier receives these same bytes/digest. Neither path: original void/no new work. Carrier-only: same in-memory wrapper, no legacy path/readback dependency.
TXWrapperHandoff.legacyErrors: Original serialization/write errors when legacy output requested remain genuine hook exceptions and propagate through original observe try/catch/finally cleanup aggregation. Do not catch/reclassify them as carrier-only failure or suppress product errors. Legacy-only default behavior/bytes unchanged.
TXWrapperHandoff.carrierOnlyHookError: If no legacy output was requested, failure of the NEW carrier-only serialization/return is caught in that new branch; return void and fixed carrier unavailable state. It must not throw out of observe or prevent genuine assertions. Never catch an original legacy error with this new branch.
TXWrapperHandoff.acceptanceBoundary: Invoke original hook under its original error path. Separately catch ONLY new handoff capture/validation/assembly/sidecar operations. Missing/malformed/oversize/digest mismatch/JSON projection refusal creates sticky failed carrier with rawWrapperSha256:null; no return replacement or throw. On valid handoff retain exact bytes only transiently, no new raw wrapper output. Sidecar IO refusal likewise never converts to carrier success or escapes observe.

jsonRepresentationComparison.rule: Require all three own actual fields and successful projections. Compare explicit JSON representation, including normal omission of undefined object members and null array representation. Fixed evidence failure for missing/refused projection. sourceCommit/entry still match actual fixed provenance.
jsonRepresentationComparison.rawIdentity: Raw wrapper digest is SHA256 of exact handoff bytes, unchanged by JSON comparison. canonicalResultSha256 remains separate derived result-data identity. No normalization/exclusion/fixedpoint/source/config/payload identity changes.

TXWrapperHandoff.failureVisibility: Fixed code/stage only, no raw message/cause/path/token. Safe attempt failure retained when writable; absent sidecar remains an explicit failing validation observation. Return unchanged genuine observed; caller product assertions proceed. Later exact evidence validation rejects missing/invalid carrier independently. Cleanup failure is sticky, original genuine result preserved. Ownership remains unverified.
